_about: Overrides for backend/ingest.py duplicate handling. Keys are PDF file names in the knowledge base.
A PDF named as source_file by JSON menu records is automatically represented by those records: kept for citation links, not embedded.
superseded: PDFs that must not be embedded (e.g. an older menu replaced by a newer one). Value = reason.
index_anyway: PDFs to embed even though JSON records name them as their source, or to accept after a needs_review warning.
